description.default: Browse local workspace with file preview, Markdown preview, Git status, REST request sending, terminal and project command running.
description.zh-CN: 本地工作区文件浏览器，支持代码与 Markdown 预览、Git 状态、REST 请求发送、交互式终端和项目命令运行。
description.zh-TW: 本機工作區檔案瀏覽器，支援程式碼與 Markdown 預覽、Git 狀態、REST 請求送出、互動式終端機與專案命令執行。

description.default: Annotation workspace inside a Snow panel: import images (drag / pick / paste) or video, annotate regions, move and resize them, explode layouts, then export feedback JSON, annotated PNG or a project ZIP into the workspace and write the JSON straight back into the chat composer. Saved projects are listed for one-click re-import. The panel runs in an iframe so the upstream styles stay isolated, and exports go through the Snow bridge because native downloads and the clipboard API do not work inside an iframe. Ships third-party front-end code licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (non-commercial use only).
description.zh-CN: 批注工作台：导入图片（拖入 / 选择 / 粘贴）或视频，做区域批注、移动缩放与大爆炸布局，导出反馈 JSON / 标注 PNG / 项目 ZIP 到工作区，并把 JSON 直接回填聊天草稿；保存过的项目会进「最近项目」列表，可一键重新导入。面板以 iframe 隔离上游样式，导出统一经 Snow 桥落盘（原生下载与剪贴板在 iframe 内不可用）。内含按 PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 授权的第三方前端代码，仅限非商业用途。
description.zh-TW: 批註工作台：匯入圖片（拖入 / 選擇 / 貼上）或影片，做區域批註、移動縮放與大爆炸佈局，匯出回饋 JSON / 標註 PNG / 專案 ZIP 到工作區，並把 JSON 直接回填聊天草稿；儲存過的專案會進「最近專案」清單，可一鍵重新匯入。面板以 iframe 隔離上游樣式，匯出統一經 Snow 橋落盤（原生下載與剪貼簿在 iframe 內不可用）。內含按 PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 授權的第三方前端程式碼，僅限非商業用途。

description.default: Local usage panel with five rate metrics: RPD, TPD, RPM, ITPM and OTPM. Shows range averages, minute peaks and live rolling windows, with a pointer readout on the sparklines. Reads only the local usage domain and does not split by API profile.
description.zh-CN: 本机用量面板，统计 RPD / TPD / RPM / ITPM / OTPM 五个指标：区间均值、分钟峰值与实时滚动窗口，指针停在曲线上可读该时刻各指标数值。只读本机 usage 域，不区分 API 档案。

description.default: Ask side questions in a panel with its own input box. Answers stream into the panel only: never filled into the composer, never sent, never written to the conversation history (the Q&A log lives in plugin-private storage). The focused conversation is auto-attached as context and refreshed when you switch conversations. The Progress report button summarizes the main conversation's current task (/btw style: done / in progress / todo / blockers), and can also run automatically at an interval while the main session is streaming. Answers render as Markdown with tool-call markers stripped. Requests never carry conversationId, reuse the current API profile and ask for no extra API key.
description.zh-CN: 在面板内用自己的输入框提旁路问题，回答只流式显示在面板里：不回填输入框、不发送、不写入会话历史（问答记录只存在插件私有存储）。自动携带焦点会话作为上下文，切换会话时自动失效并重新读取。「进度报告」按 /btw 的语义对主会话当前任务生成进度总结（已完成 / 进行中 / 待办 / 阻塞或风险），主会话运行中还能按间隔自动生成。回答按 Markdown 渲染，并自动清洗模型吐出的工具调用标记。请求不传 conversationId，复用当前 API 档案，不额外索取密钥。
description.zh-TW: 在面板內用自己的輸入框提旁路問題，回答只串流顯示在面板裡：不回填輸入框、不傳送、不寫入會話歷史（問答記錄只存在外掛私有儲存）。自動攜帶焦點會話作為上下文，切換會話時自動失效並重新讀取。「進度報告」按 /btw 的語義對主會話目前任務產生進度總結（已完成 / 進行中 / 待辦 / 阻塞或風險），主會話執行中還可按間隔自動產生。回答按 Markdown 呈現，並自動清洗模型吐出的工具呼叫標記。請求不傳 conversationId，重用目前 API 檔案，不額外索取密鑰。

description.default: Browse and install community agent skills from aggregated public indexes (official / local / community sources / skills.sh), with search, collapsible category filters, paged list, global or project install location, one-click or AI-assisted install.
description.zh-CN: 聚合公开技能索引（官方技能 / 本地技能 / 社区源 / skills.sh），支持搜索、分类折叠过滤、分页浏览、全局或项目级一键安装或让 AI 代装；skills.sh 卡片描述自动从详情页补齐。

description.default: Anonymous chat panel for hack.chat (shown as ?SNOW) via a local zero-dependency bridge process. Persistent nickname across reconnects, member list, proxy auto-detect. Requires Node.js 14+ and terminal permission.
description.zh-CN: 基于 hack.chat 的匿名聊天面板（界面显示 ?SNOW），经本机零依赖桥接进程连接（宿主网络策略禁止面板直连外网）。昵称持久化不随重连变化，支持成员列表、代理自动探测、桥端口与自动连接设置。需 Node.js 14+ 与终端权限。
description.zh-TW: 基於 hack.chat 的匿名聊天面板（界面顯示 ?SNOW），經本機零依賴橋接程序連接（宿主網路策略禁止面板直連外網）。暱稱持久化不隨重連變化，支援成員列表、代理自動探測、橋埠與自動連線設定。需 Node.js 14+ 與終端權限。

description.default: Start / stop / restart the local whisper.cpp transcription service and manage its models (multi-backend CUDA / Vulkan / CPU). Zero-config: stt_server.py ships with the plugin, the CPU whisper runtime auto-downloads on first start, and models download from the built-in library. Must be used together with the "Voice Input & Read Aloud" client script: this panel only runs the service and provides no voice input by itself.
description.zh-CN: 启动 / 停止 / 重启本地 whisper.cpp 转写服务并管理识别模型，支持 CUDA / Vulkan / CPU 多后端自动择优。零配置：stt_server.py 随插件自带，服务目录留空自动定位，首次启动自动下载 CPU 运行时，模型在面板模型库下载，还可一键让 AI 帮装 GPU 后端。需与「语音输入与朗读」客户端脚本配合使用：本面板只负责起服务，本身不提供语音输入。

description.default: Industry-convention TPS/TTFT metrics plus a live overview of all running sessions (including sub-agents).
description.zh-CN: 按行业口径计算 TPS/TTFT，并汇总全部运行中会话（含子代理）的实时状态。

description.default: Estimate API usage cost from usage statistics with built-in / OpenRouter-synced per-model prices, daily cost chart and CSV export. Publishes its normalized price table as a snapshot for client scripts (e.g. session-stats-pills).
description.zh-CN: 读取使用量统计，按内置官方刊例/OpenRouter 换算单价估算各模型 API 使用成本，支持每日成本条形图与 CSV 导出，可一键从 OpenRouter 同步价格；并把归一化价格表发布为快照，供客户端脚本（如「会话统计条」）复用同一套单价。

description.default: One panel for fund NAV, A-share/US/HK quotes and crypto: intraday and candlestick charts, a cost-basis trading ledger (buy/sell/realized P&L), market sessions, symbol search, portfolio overview and CSV export.
description.zh-CN: 一个面板装下基金、行情与大饼：净值、实时报价、分时与日 K 蜡烛图、按成本价记账的买入/卖出与浮动/已实现盈亏、行内记仓、组合总览与导出 CSV、交易时段状态、名称/拼音搜索。数据源为公开接口，仅通过 api.net.fetch 读取。

description.default: WeChat group-chat feed, statistics and reports, plus an MCP tool console — backed by a locally installed wechat MCP server (read-only). Renders decrypted chat images and real emoticons, builds member profiles, and exports daily/weekly/monthly/yearly reports as Markdown or an HTML long image.
description.zh-CN: 基于本机 wechat MCP 的微信群聊信息流、统计与报告，以及可直接调用的 MCP 工具台（只读）。支持聊天图片解密直出、真实表情渲染、成员画像，以及日报/周报/月报/年报导出为 Markdown 或 HTML 长图。
description.zh-TW: 基於本機 wechat MCP 的微信群聊資訊流、統計與報告，以及可直接呼叫的 MCP 工具台（唯讀）。支援聊天圖片解密直出、真實表情渲染、成員畫像，以及日報/週報/月報/年報匯出為 Markdown 或 HTML 長圖。

description.default: Inspect and operate local Docker containers, images and Compose projects from the Agent.
description.en: Inspect and operate local Docker containers, images and Compose projects from the Agent.
description.zh-CN: 在 Agent 中查看和操作本机 Docker 容器、镜像与 Compose 项目，支持日志、inspect、启停删、exec 和资源排查。
description.zh-TW: 在 Agent 中檢視和操作本機 Docker 容器、映像與 Compose 專案，支援日誌、inspect、啟停刪、exec 和資源排查。

description.default: Unified cards for external MCP tool calls: argument summaries, tables, content blocks and error states, covering 24 search and developer services such as Anysearch, DBX, Firecrawl and Chrome DevTools. Requires a compatible desktop host.
description.zh-CN: 为外部 MCP 工具调用提供统一卡片：参数摘要、表格、内容块与错误状态，覆盖 Anysearch、DBX、Firecrawl、Chrome DevTools 等 24 类搜索与开发服务。需配套支持工具卡插槽的桌面宿主。
description.zh-TW: 為外部 MCP 工具呼叫提供統一卡片：參數摘要、表格、內容區塊與錯誤狀態，覆蓋 Anysearch、DBX、Firecrawl、Chrome DevTools 等 24 類搜尋與開發服務。需配套支援工具卡插槽的桌面宿主。
description.en: Unified cards for external MCP tool calls: argument summaries, tables, content blocks and error states, covering 24 search and developer services such as Anysearch, DBX, Firecrawl and Chrome DevTools. Requires a compatible desktop host.

description.default: Drive this machine's ffmpeg/ffprobe from the agent: environment and capability checks, probing, black-frame/silence/scene analysis, transcoding with two-pass and rate control, trimming, frame grabs, GIF/WebP export, waveforms and spectrograms, effects and grading, crop and text, subtitle burn-in and muxing, metadata and chapters, concat and Ken Burns slideshows, overlay and audio mixing, HLS/DASH packaging and RTMP/SRT pushing, screen and device capture, plus a raw argv escape hatch. Local only, never uploads, and reports install guidance when ffmpeg is missing.
description.zh-CN: 在本机用 ffmpeg/ffprobe 处理你指定的图片、音频与视频：环境自检与能力查询、信息探测、黑帧/静音/场景等分析、转码压缩（含两遍编码与码率控制）、剪辑、抽帧、GIF/WebP 动图、波形与频谱图、特效调色、裁剪打字、字幕烧录与封装、元数据与章节、拼接与运镜幻灯片、图层与混音、HLS/DASH 打包与推流、录屏与设备采集，以及任意参数的兜底直通。默认不联网、不上传，未安装 ffmpeg 时给出安装引导。
description.zh-TW: 在本機用 ffmpeg/ffprobe 處理你指定的圖片、音訊與影片：環境自檢與能力查詢、資訊探測、黑幀／靜音／場景等分析、轉碼壓縮（含兩遍編碼與位元率控制）、剪輯、抽幀、GIF/WebP 動圖、波形與頻譜圖、特效調色、裁剪打字、字幕燒錄與封裝、中繼資料與章節、拼接與運鏡幻燈片、圖層與混音、HLS/DASH 打包與串流、螢幕與裝置擷取，以及任意參數的兜底直通。預設不連網、不上傳，未安裝 ffmpeg 時提供安裝引導。
description.en: Drive this machine's ffmpeg/ffprobe from the agent: environment and capability checks, probing, black-frame/silence/scene analysis, transcoding with two-pass and rate control, trimming, frame grabs, GIF/WebP export, waveforms and spectrograms, effects and grading, crop and text, subtitle burn-in and muxing, metadata and chapters, concat and Ken Burns slideshows, overlay and audio mixing, HLS/DASH packaging and RTMP/SRT pushing, screen and device capture, plus a raw argv escape hatch. Local only, never uploads, and reports install guidance when ffmpeg is missing.

description.zh-TW: 客戶端腳本外掛：聊天輸入框工具列扳手入口與置中浮層工作台，涵蓋程式碼審查、issue 追蹤、批次修復與結果清理的閉環；另帶視窗頂部可拖動的跨專案執行監控面板，issue 依專案隔離儲存在腳本私有儲存。
description.default: Client script plugin: a floating workbench opened from the chat input toolbar, covering code review, issue tracking, batch fixing and result cleanup, plus a draggable cross-project execution monitor at the top of the window; issues are stored per project in the script's private storage.
description.zh-CN: 客户端脚本插件：聊天输入框工具栏扳手入口与居中浮层工作台，覆盖代码审查、issue 跟踪、批量修复与结果清理的闭环；另带窗口顶部可拖动的跨项目执行监控面板，issue 按项目隔离保存在脚本私有存储。

description.default: GitHub tools with built-in result cards for repositories, issues, commits, pull requests, files, code search, releases, Actions, GraphQL, comments, reviews and remote writes.
description.en: GitHub tools with built-in result cards for repositories, issues, commits, pull requests, files, code search, releases, Actions, GraphQL, comments, reviews and remote writes.
description.zh-CN: GitHub 工具，自带结果卡片：查询仓库、议题、提交、PR、文件、代码与 Actions，执行 GraphQL，并支持评论、审查、Revert PR、Release 资产和远端写操作。
description.zh-TW: GitHub 工具，自帶結果卡片：查詢儲存庫、議題、提交、PR、檔案、程式碼與 Actions，執行 GraphQL，並支援評論、審查、Revert PR、Release 資產和遠端寫操作。

description.default: Short-drama panel for Hongguo: recommendations, rankings, category filters, trending searches, suggestions, automatic search pagination, series details, episode list, in-panel WebCodecs decoding with quality switching, parallel startup loading, next-episode prefetch, per-episode resume history, a watchlist, and saved playback preferences. The panel talks only to this plugin's own background service over a loopback-only HTTP channel; the background uses the unofficial anonymous openhongguo SDK to read public catalogue and playback data. No account, no upload, no host data access.
description.en: Short-drama panel for Hongguo: recommendations, rankings, category filters, trending searches, suggestions, automatic search pagination, series details, episode list, in-panel WebCodecs decoding with quality switching, parallel startup loading, next-episode prefetch, per-episode resume history, a watchlist, and saved playback preferences. The panel talks only to this plugin's own background service over a loopback-only HTTP channel; the background uses the unofficial anonymous openhongguo SDK to read public catalogue and playback data. No account, no upload, no host data access.
description.zh-CN: 红果短剧面板：推荐、排行、分类筛选、热搜、输入联想、搜索触底加载、详情、分集、本机 WebCodecs 解码播放与清晰度切换、起播并行读取、下一集预加载、逐集续播历史、收藏追剧与播放偏好记忆。面板只与本插件自己的后台服务通信（仅监听 127.0.0.1 的回环 HTTP 通道）；后台使用非官方匿名 SDK openhongguo 读取红果短剧的公开目录与播放数据。不登录账号、不上传任何数据、不读取宿主数据。
description.zh-TW: 紅果短劇面板：推薦、排行、分類篩選、熱搜、輸入聯想、搜尋觸底載入、詳情、分集、本機 WebCodecs 解碼播放與清晰度切換、起播並行讀取、下一集預載入、逐集續播歷史、收藏追劇與播放偏好記憶。面板只與本外掛自己的後台服務通訊（僅監聽 127.0.0.1 的回環 HTTP 通道）；後台使用非官方匿名 SDK openhongguo 讀取紅果短劇的公開目錄與播放資料。不登入帳號、不上傳任何資料、不讀取宿主資料。

description.default: Novel reader with a floating TXT reading window (adjustable opacity and position, wheel and hotkey paging, auto hide on mouse leave, chapter detection and auto scroll), plus legado book-source import, multi-source search and online chapter reading with caching.
description.zh-CN: 小说阅读器：悬浮 TXT 阅读窗（可调透明度与显示位置、滚轮与快捷键翻页、鼠标移入显示移出隐藏、章节识别与自动滚动），并支持导入 legado 书源、多源并发搜索、在线追书与章节缓存。
description.zh-TW: 小說閱讀器：懸浮 TXT 閱讀窗（可調不透明度與顯示位置、滾輪與快捷鍵翻頁，滑鼠移入顯示移出隱藏、章節識別與自動捲動），並支援匯入 legado 書源、多源並發搜尋、線上追書與章節快取。

description.default: Configure rewriting rules and optimize drafts from the input toolbar with safe fill and undo. Requires the new host plugin APIs.
description.zh-CN: 配置优化规则、上下文与模型，输入栏一键改写，安全回填与还原，不自动发送。需要新版宿主插件接口。
description.zh-TW: 設定優化規則、上下文與模型，輸入欄一鍵改寫，安全回填與還原，不自動傳送。需要新版宿主外掛介面。

description.default: Show recorded conversation files below the latest completed reply, including sub-agents. Requires the new host footer and tracking APIs.
description.zh-CN: 在最新已结束回复下方展示当前会话及子代理已记录文件数量与清单。需要新版宿主回复插槽与追踪接口。
description.zh-TW: 在最新已結束回覆下方顯示目前會話及子代理已記錄檔案數量與清單。需要新版宿主回覆插槽與追蹤介面。

description.default: Live session trajectory and run data: streaming metrics, TODO progress, tool-call timeline, file changes and sub-agents, following the active conversation.
description.zh-CN: 实时查看会话的运行轨迹与数据：流式指标、TODO 进度、工具调用时间线、文件改动与子代理，跟随当前会话自动切换。
description.zh-TW: 即時檢視會話的執行軌跡與資料：串流指標、TODO 進度、工具呼叫時間軸、檔案變更與子代理，跟隨當前會話自動切換。

description.default: Client script plugin: a persistent capsule at the top center of the window (or a topbar badge) showing today's tokens and the cost estimated from catalog list prices, with today / last 7 days / last 30 days / all-time periods, per-model breakdown, cache hit rate and per-request precision, price catalogs from OpenRouter, models.dev or LiteLLM (tiers and 1h cache-write pricing), custom prices, manual model mapping and K/M/B compact counts.
description.zh-CN: 客户端脚本插件：常驻窗口顶部中间与顶栏同一行的胶囊（也可切成顶栏徽标），显示今日 token 与按目录挂牌价估算的花费；含今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部四个周期、按模型拆分、缓存命中率与逐请求精算，价格目录可选 OpenRouter、models.dev 或 LiteLLM（含档位价与 1h 缓存写价），支持自定义价、手动模型映射与 K/M/B 紧凑计数。
description.zh-TW: 客戶端腳本外掛：常駐視窗頂部中間與頂欄同一行的膠囊（也可切成頂欄徽標），顯示今日 token 與依目錄掛牌價估算的花費；含今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部四個週期、依模型拆分、快取命中率與逐請求精算，價格目錄可選 OpenRouter、models.dev 或 LiteLLM（含檔位價與 1 小時快取寫價），支援自訂價、手動模型對應與 K/M/B 緊湊計數。

description.default: Read assistant replies with Xiaomi MiMo TTS: preset / designed / cloned voices, sentence pipeline playback, auto-broadcast, browser speech fallback and local audio history.
description.zh-CN: 接入小米 MiMo TTS 朗读助手回复：预置 / 设计 / 复刻三种音色，分句流水线播放、自动播报、浏览器本地语音兜底与本地音频历史。
description.zh-TW: 接入小米 MiMo TTS 朗讀助手回覆：預置 / 設計 / 複刻三種音色，分句流水線播放、自動播報、瀏覽器本地語音兜底與本地音訊歷史。

description.default: Copy project memories and memos between projects (local or SSH) without touching the source. Per-item selection, duplicate detection, two-step confirmation and one-click undo.
description.zh-CN: 在项目之间复制项目记忆与备忘录（本机或 SSH 均可），源项目全程只读。支持逐条勾选、自动去重、两步确认与一键撤销。

description.default: Sign in to Devin through the Devin CLI's browser PKCE flow, with the callback completing on 127.0.0.1. Chat works through a custom transport (Snow App 0.5.6+): each turn is handed to Devin's Connect RPC / protobuf layer, so streamed replies, tool calls and usage come from the same encoder the CLI uses. Models and quota are available too. The session token has no refresh. Typewriter streaming is bypassed, so the provider is marked "custom transport".
description.zh-CN: 通过 Devin CLI 的浏览器 PKCE 登录 Devin 订阅账号，回调在 127.0.0.1 自动完成。对话经插件的自定义传输接管（需 Snow App 0.5.6+）：每轮请求交给 Devin 的 Connect RPC / protobuf 层，流式回复、工具调用与用量都出自 CLI 同一套编解码；模型列表与额度面板同样可用。会话令牌无续期。接管会绕过宿主的打字机式流式，来源列表标注「自定义传输」。
description.zh-TW: 透過 Devin CLI 的瀏覽器 PKCE 登入 Devin 訂閱帳號，回呼在 127.0.0.1 自動完成。對話由外掛的自訂傳輸接管（需 Snow App 0.5.6+）：每一輪請求交給 Devin 的 Connect RPC / protobuf 層，串流回覆、工具呼叫與用量都出自 CLI 同一套編解碼；模型清單與額度面板同樣可用。工作階段權杖無續期。接管會略過宿主端的打字機式串流，來源清單標註「自訂傳輸」。

description.default: Sign in to iFlytek Loomy with a phone number and an SMS code inside the OAuth dialog's own panel. The plugin runs a loopback-only (127.0.0.1) local service that sends and verifies the code, so the token still comes from the host's poll hook. Uses Loomy's OpenAI-compatible model gateway. Requires Snow App 0.5.6+. Session lasts 14 days with no refresh.
description.zh-CN: 在 OAuth 登录弹窗自带的 panel 里用手机号 + 短信验证码登录讯飞 Loomy：适配层起一个只监听 127.0.0.1 的本地服务负责发码与验码，令牌仍由宿主轮询取得。登录后使用其 OpenAI 兼容模型网关。需要 Snow App 0.5.6+。会话 14 天，无续期。
description.zh-TW: 在 OAuth 登入彈窗自帶的 panel 裡用手機號 + 簡訊驗證碼登入訊飛 Loomy：適配層起一個只監聽 127.0.0.1 的本機服務負責發碼與驗碼，權杖仍由宿主輪詢取得。登入後使用其 OpenAI 相容模型閘道。需要 Snow App 0.5.6+。工作階段 14 天，無續期。

description.default: Sign in to SenseTime Raccoon from one panel, two ways: open the desktop authorization page and let the 127.0.0.1 callback finish automatically, or paste the office-raccoon:// callback link (or a JWT access token) back into the panel. Requires Snow App 0.5.6+.
description.zh-CN: 在单一 panel 里用两种方式登录商汤小浣熊：点「打开授权页」在浏览器授权后由 127.0.0.1 本地回调自动完成，或把 office-raccoon:// 回调链接（也支持 JWT access token）粘回面板提交。需要 Snow App 0.5.6+。
description.zh-TW: 在單一 panel 裡用兩種方式登入商湯小浣熊：點「開啟授權頁」在瀏覽器授權後由 127.0.0.1 本機回呼自動完成，或把 office-raccoon:// 回呼連結（也支援 JWT access token）貼回面板提交。需要 Snow App 0.5.6+。

name.default: Conversation menu: copy last AI message
name.zh-CN: 会话菜单：复制最后一条 AI 消息
name.zh-TW: 會話選單：複製最後一則 AI 訊息

description.default: Adds a "Copy last AI message" item to the sidebar conversation menu (⋯ / right-click) and copies that conversation's last AI reply to the clipboard.
description.zh-CN: 在侧边栏会话的「⋯」/ 右键菜单中新增一项「复制最后一条AI消息」，一键把该会话的最后一条 AI 回复复制到剪贴板。
description.zh-TW: 在側邊欄會話的「⋯」/ 右鍵選單中新增一項「複製最後一則 AI 訊息」，一鍵把該會話最後一則 AI 回覆複製到剪貼簿。

name.default: Eye Care Ball · Follow the Light

description.default: 90-second eye workout: follow a glowing ball for smooth pursuit, saccades and near–far focus to relax the ciliary muscle. Reminder text travels with the ball — move your eyes, not your neck. Entry: the “Eye care” button on the right of the top bar.
description.zh-CN: 90 秒护眼操：眼球跟随光球做平滑追踪、快速扫视与远近调焦，锻炼并放松睫状肌。提醒文字贴着光球移动 —— 只动眼球，不转脖子。入口：顶栏右侧的「护眼操」按钮。
description.zh-TW: 90 秒護眼操：眼球跟隨光球做平滑追蹤、快速掃視與遠近調焦，鍛鍊並放鬆睫狀肌。提醒文字貼著光球移動 —— 只動眼球，不轉脖子。入口：頂欄右側的「護眼操」按鈕。

description.default: Client script: get notified when an AI turn finishes — push via 7 channels (ServerChan / PushPlus / Bark / DingTalk / WeCom / Telegram / Feishu), chime and in-app toast. Also watches background conversations: a turn finishing while you are in another conversation still notifies. Settings open from the bell button in the top bar (next to the todo list button when present, otherwise in the same top-bar position).
description.zh-CN: 客户端脚本：一轮 AI 回复结束时提醒 —— 7 渠道推送（Server酱 / PushPlus / Bark / 钉钉 / 企业微信 / Telegram / 飞书）+ 提示音 + 应用内提示条。支持后台会话：切到其他会话时，原会话跑完同样提醒。设置入口在顶栏铃铛按钮（有待办时在待办列表按钮右侧，无待办时停在同一顶栏位置）。

description.default: Client script: render your own quick prompts as chips above the chat input, in the same row as other plugin buttons (placed first in that row). Click a chip to send that text to the current conversation; a settings switch can make it fill the input box instead so you confirm before sending. The gear icon opens a settings dialog to add, edit, reorder and delete prompts (deleting needs a second click), plus a backup section that exports the list as JSON (copy to clipboard) or imports pasted JSON into the draft. Prompts live in the script's private GM storage, so reinstalling or updating the script never clears them; no network access, colors follow the app theme.
description.zh-CN: 客户端脚本：把自定义的若干条提示词渲染成聊天输入框上方的芯片按钮（与语音等插件按钮同处一行、排在行首，不额外占行），点一下即以该条内容发送给当前会话；设置里可切换为「只填入输入框」，由你确认后再发送。条尾齿轮打开设置浮层：增删提示词、上下移动排序，删除需二次确认，底部「备份与恢复」可把列表导出成 JSON（复制到系统剪贴板）或把粘贴的 JSON 导入到草稿。提示词存在脚本私有 GM 存储，重装或更新脚本都不会清空；无网络请求，配色跟随应用主题。

description.default: Client script: shows the five usage metrics (RPD / TPD / RPM / ITPM / OTPM) as freely draggable pills, centered below the top bar by default. Each pill can be shown or hidden individually, and the gauge button in the host top bar opens a menu with per-pill toggles, show / hide all, range switching, layout reset and refresh now. Refresh interval and glow duration are picked with level sliders (refresh 1 / 2 / 5 / 10 / 30 / 60s; glow 3 / 5 / 8 / 12s or continuous). Pill width adapts to its content, so long numbers are neither clipped nor overlapping. Reads the local usage metadata domain only - no network, no API profile list.
description.zh-CN: 客户端脚本：把 RPD / TPD / RPM / ITPM / OTPM 五项用量指标显示成可自由拖放的胶囊，默认居中在顶栏下方。每颗可单独显示或隐藏；顶栏仪表按钮打开菜单，可逐颗开关、全部显示 / 隐藏、切换统计范围、重置位置与立即刷新。刷新速度与光效时长用档位滑块选择（刷新 1/2/5/10/30/60 秒，光效 3/5/8/12 秒或「持续不停」）。胶囊宽度随内容自适应，长数字不裁字也不叠字。只读本机 usage 元数据域，不联网、不读 API 档案列表。

description.default: Client script: a centered pill row right below the chat input showing the current session's turns and steps, instantaneous output speed, cache hit rate, input and output tokens, and session cost. The speed pill uses a 3-second sliding window (streamTokenCount delta over actual span) instead of the cumulative average. The cost pill opens a per-model breakdown (four token buckets, unit prices, price source, snapshot time). Prices are read from the Usage Cost plugin's published snapshot, falling back to the same built-in price rules when no snapshot exists. The cache hit rate uses exactly the same source and formula as the composer's token usage ring (runtime.tokenUsage, cacheRead = min(cacheRead, input), one decimal), while turns / input / output / cost use the whole-session billing view from usage records - both rates are listed in the popover. Every pill can be toggled independently, the refresh interval is selectable (3s / 5s / 10s), and the row hides itself on a new chat.
description.zh-CN: 客户端脚本：在聊天输入框正下方居中显示一行药丸，展示当前会话的轮次与步数、瞬时输出速度、缓存命中率、输入输出 token 与会话成本。速度药丸用 3 秒滑动窗口（streamTokenCount 增量 ÷ 实际跨度）计算瞬时 TPS，不再用累计平均口径；点成本药丸展开按模型拆分的明细（四桶 token、单价、单价来源、快照时间）；单价读取「成本核算看板」发布的快照，读不到时回落到同一套内置规则；缓存命中率与输入框右侧用量环同源同公式（runtime.tokenUsage，cacheRead = min(cacheRead, input)，保留 1 位小数），轮次 / 输入输出 / 成本则走 usage 明细的全会话账单口径，两个命中率都在浮层里列出。五个药丸可单独开关，刷新间隔可选 3s / 5s / 10s，新会话时整行自动隐藏。

description.default: Client script: enhance the chat input context ring. The host's own hover figures (input / output / cache / total / cache hit rate / context window) are merged into a single panel together with a context breakdown. Message volume and built-in overhead are measured from the real request tokens (the first request's input of this conversation is used as the baseline); only system prompt / skills list / MCP tool definitions are apportioned by text length and marked with a leading ≈.
description.zh-CN: 客户端脚本：增强聊天输入区的上下文圆环。宿主原生的悬停用量（输入 / 输出 / 缓存 / 合计 / 缓存命中率 / 上下文上限）并入同一块面板，并追加上下文分解。消息量与内置工具开销取自真实请求 token（用本会话首轮请求的 input 作为基线），只有系统提示词 / 技能清单 / MCP 工具定义按文本长度分摊并标 ≈；拿不到首轮记录时自动退回纯文本估算并注明。

description.default: Client script: record voice input transcribed by a local Whisper service and read AI replies aloud with the system TTS. Must be used together with the "Local Speech Service" panel plugin (zero-config since v1.5.0: the service script ships with the panel and the CPU runtime auto-downloads), which starts/stops the local service and manages models. NOTE: renamed in v1.5.2 - uninstall any older entry before installing.
description.zh-CN: 客户端脚本：语音输入（本机 Whisper 转写）+ AI 回复朗读（系统 TTS）。需与「本地语音服务」面板插件配合使用（面板 1.5.0 起零配置：服务脚本随插件自带、CPU 运行时自动下载）：由面板一键启停本地转写服务、管理识别模型，本脚本本身不含模型。注意：v1.5.2 起脚本改名为「语音输入与朗读」，升级前请先卸载旧条目。

description.default: Sign in to Trae China (trae.cn) or Trae Global (trae.ai) through the IDE's browser sign-in; one plugin ships both providers. Chat works by translating Trae's private SSE: transformRequest rebuilds the outbound URL, body and IDE headers, onResponseChunk turns every private event into an OpenAI chat.completion.chunk, and transformResponse rewrites the whole-body error reply. Refresh, models and quota are available too. Requires Snow App 0.5.6+.
description.zh-CN: 一个插件同时提供 Trae 国内版（trae.cn）与国际版（trae.ai）两个 provider，走 Trae IDE 的浏览器登录。对话靠逐事件翻译 Trae 私有 SSE：transformRequest 重建出站 URL、请求体与 IDE 头，onResponseChunk 把每个私有事件翻成 OpenAI chat.completion.chunk，transformResponse 处理整段错误正文。续期、模型列表与额度面板同样可用。需要 Snow App 0.5.6+。
description.zh-TW: 一個外掛同時提供 Trae 國內版（trae.cn）與國際版（trae.ai）兩個 provider，走 Trae IDE 的瀏覽器登入。對話靠逐事件翻譯 Trae 私有 SSE：transformRequest 重建出站 URL、請求主體與 IDE 標頭，onResponseChunk 把每個私有事件翻成 OpenAI chat.completion.chunk，transformResponse 處理整段錯誤回應。續期、模型清單與額度面板同樣可用。需要 Snow App 0.5.6+。

description.default: Sign in to WorkBuddy China (copilot.tencent.com) or WorkBuddy Global (www.workbuddy.ai) from a single provider. The sign-in panel asks which site to use; the chosen site is stored on the profile, and refresh / models / quota / chat all follow it with the request origin rewritten per site. Requires Snow App 0.5.6+.
description.zh-CN: 一个 provider 覆盖 WorkBuddy 国内版（copilot.tencent.com）与国际版（www.workbuddy.ai）：登录 panel 里选站点，命中的站点记进档案，之后续期 / 模型 / 额度 / 对话都按它走，出站 URL 按站点改写 origin。需要 Snow App 0.5.6+。
description.zh-TW: 一個 provider 覆蓋 WorkBuddy 國內版（copilot.tencent.com）與國際版（www.workbuddy.ai）：登入 panel 裡選站點，命中的站點記進檔案，之後續期 / 模型 / 額度 / 對話都依它走，出站 URL 依站點改寫 origin。需要 Snow App 0.5.6+。

description.default: Sign in to ZCode (Z.ai / BigModel GLM Coding Plan) through its browser sign-in. Individual and team-seat accounts speak plain Anthropic Messages; the Start Plan account's outbound disguise is applied by transformRequest and its refusal text by transformResponse. Models and quota are available. Requires Snow App 0.5.6+.
description.zh-CN: 通过 ZCode 的浏览器登录添加 Z.ai 或 BigModel（智谱）GLM Coding Plan 账号。个体订阅与团队席位走标准 Anthropic Messages；Start Plan 的出站伪装由 transformRequest 补齐，被拒文案由 transformResponse 处理。模型列表与额度面板可用。需要 Snow App 0.5.6+。
description.zh-TW: 透過 ZCode 的瀏覽器登入加入 Z.ai 或 BigModel（智譜）GLM Coding Plan 帳號。個人訂閱與團隊席次走標準 Anthropic Messages；Start Plan 的出站偽裝由 transformRequest 補齊，被拒文案由 transformResponse 處理。模型清單與額度面板可用。需要 Snow App 0.5.6+。
